input.text: Hey Mike — I don't have access to the CRM/deal data from here (I'm a code tool, not wired into the sales pipeline), so I can't pull the current Umbrella deal status. Best bet is to check the deal record directly or loop in whoever owns the account. Happy to help if you need something dug out of the codebase or a report run against the DB.
